warmState: Native metadata opened once for reusable windows and raw tile; pure planning reuses that index. Cold lane opens a fresh index. Both raster and derived raw tile receive finite 64 GiB / 10M-request lifetime allowances; per-read defaults remain in force.
untimedPreflight: Every original sample, complete physical raw block and selected lane sample; exact plan/source/request and integrity scope.
firstFailure: First timing failed when reused raw block source exhausted its separate default request lifetime. First report/stderr/state/input retained. Setup-only repair explicitly passes the same finite sampling allowance to source creation.
scope: Small native fixtures, Node/Linux ARM64, distinct operation contracts. No SDK-speed, codec, rendering, COG or CRS-conformance comparison.
externalActivity: Start/end Docker stats retained. Any unrelated workspace activity is outside this benchmark owner; snapshots cannot prove absence of short-lived activity between observations.
